senses.gloss:
Any,Ⓒa.ⒹEx. by cit, cana, or api with the forms of kim; ‘a(ny) man’ kopi naraH; ‘a(ny) woman’ kAcitstrI &c., ‘at a(ny) time’ kadAcit.
Ⓑ
 2 (Any whosoever) Ex. by forms of yat with the above; yaH kaScanAgacCatu ‘let a(ny) come’; ‘I may be a(ny) one’ yo vA ko vA BavAmyahaM; ‘a(ny)how’ kaTaMcit, yena kena prakAreRa, yaTA kaTaMcit; ‘a(ny) longer’ punaH, itaH-ataH-paraM, ‘a(ny)where’ kutrApi, kvacidapi; ‘a(ny)thing’ Izadapi, stokamapi.
